title: Run and observe product-wide end-to-end tests

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-334#run-and-observe-product-wide-end-to-end-tests

**Verdict: Caught.** For runner-side selection, maintained proof catches a focused runner that reads E2E Test's shard setting. The catching assertion is `dashboard/backend-tests/runtime/runner-ownership.spec.ts:137`, `expect(await run.result).toMatchObject({ status: 0, stdout: "", stderr: "" })`, in the parameterized case "<runner> normal npm / direct config from another working directory records only its own selection under its own settings". The faulted focused runner selected no tests and exited with "Error: No tests found." The claim covers only the observed path: a Playwright configuration run that inherits `OPEN_DOUGH_E2E_SPLIT`.

**Story and revision.** SEED-334#run-and-observe-product-wide-end-to-end-tests at `263a2446238e8504001a8bce9ff14ee95b81bdfd`.

**Promise.** Key example 2 / Scope 1: changing E2E workers or shard allocation changes neither focused runner's selection nor settings; each group runs and reports only its own cases.

**Fault.** In `dashboard/tests/support/runnerConfig.mjs` `prepareGroupRun`: `split: process.env[variables.split],` → `split: process.env[variables.split] ?? process.env["OPEN_DOUGH_E2E_SPLIT"],` (a plausible umbrella leftover).

**Observations.** Baseline: `runner-ownership.spec.ts` 10/10; `ci-browser-groups` and `browser-group-shards` passed; independent `--list` witness frontend 153/153, backend 1411/1411, integrated 611/611 with and without `OPEN_DOUGH_E2E_SPLIT=1/6`. Faulted: witness frontend 153→4, backend 1411→185, integrated 611→96; `runner-ownership` 6 failed (all focused-runner cases, line 137, "No tests found"), 4 passed; static checks passed (they do not exercise runner environment reads). Restored: byte-identical file, 10/10, static checks passed, witness restored. Load 2.6–13; no flakiness.

**Next proof action.** None for this path. The "E2E workers" half was not probed: no E2E-only worker setting exists at this revision (workers come from the shared default or each command's `--workers`).

**Costs.** Test runtime 19.6 s / 22.0 s / 24.0 s (baseline/faulted/restored); static checks ~1 s each; human effort 0 minutes; agent effort unavailable; elapsed 253,160 ms.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision `263a2446238e8504001a8bce9ff14ee95b81bdfd`. The probe was caught by maintained proof; no actionable gap. The unprobed "E2E workers" half has no E2E-only worker input to leak at this revision (each group's config and CI caller are separate, asserted by `tests/support/ci-browser-groups.test.mjs`), so no follow-up is queued. Decision: no change; keep `runner-ownership.spec.ts` as the maintained proof.
